summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of purchase flow bug fix. Verified that POST /api/money/purchases/legacy correctly DEBITS internal FOMO Balance, activates subscription, and grants AI credits. All core functionality and edge cases tested successfully.

notes: Admin custody decomposition shows CRITICAL_MISMATCH status (knownMoneyLiabilities: $18, totalAssets: $4.06). This appears to be a pre-existing condition related to test data accumulation, not related to the purchase flow bug fix.

passed_tests: Test data setup: Created test plan ($1.00), added $10 balance to admin user
Purchase with SUFFICIENT balance - Balance debited from $8 to $7, subscription created, 100 AI credits granted, DEBIT ledger entry created
Purchase with INSUFFICIENT balance - Correctly returned 400 'Insufficient FOMO Balance' error, balance NOT debited
Idempotency test - Same idempotencyKey returned same purchase ID, balance debited ONLY ONCE
GET /api/money/me/balance - Correctly reflects reduced balance after purchase
GET /api/admin/money/custody/decomposition - Returns 200 with numeric fields and status

test_1_sufficient_balance.description: Purchase with sufficient balance ($8 available, $1 plan price)
verification: ✓ DEBIT ledger entry created with idempotencyKey: purchase_settlement:{purchaseId}

test_2_insufficient_balance.description: Purchase with insufficient balance ($7 available, $100 plan price)
verification: ✓ Error message: 'Insufficient FOMO Balance. Available 7 USDC, need 100 USDC.'

test_3_idempotency.description: Calling checkout twice with same idempotencyKey

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Public membership purchase from internal FOMO Balance did NOT debit the user's internal balance. The custody on-chain saga was parking at CUSTODY_ITEM_PENDING and never debiting.
bug_fix_verification.fix_implemented: Changed public checkout from custody on-chain saga back to internal-ledger debit flow (money.checkout -> settle) exposed at POST /api/money/purchases/legacy.
evidence: POST /api/money/purchases/legacy with sufficient balance successfully debits the internal ledger
DEBIT ledger entry is created with type: PURCHASE, direction: DEBIT
Balance calculation (available = total - reserved) correctly reflects the debit
Subscription is activated and AI credits are granted after successful debit
Insufficient balance correctly rejects with 400 error before any debit
Idempotency prevents double-debit on retry with same idempotencyKey
